meta.dataset: 31 .eml letters, research/markman-history/, Markman Capital Insight 'Tactical Options', 2021-01-07 .. 2021-03-11. CONFIRMED COMPLETE - no more emails exist.
caveats: The 31 letters skip many trading days (Jan 13-19, Jan 21-25, Jan 27, Feb 10-11, Feb 17, Feb 19-22, Mar 2 absent). Recs first seen in follow-ups are flagged missing_alert_email.
All prices marked kind=claimed are the newsletter's OWN statements, not independently verified fills.
kind=SYNTHETIC legs are Black-Scholes reconstructions (IV = max(RV20,RV60) x 1.2, close-to-close walk) - labeled, never mixed with claimed numbers silently.
The 2/4 Deere correction letter is applied: DE Feb 19 310C @7.50 replaces the erroneous Feb-5-weekly 305C @3.70.
BBBY is delisted; best-effort handling flagged on R39.
meta.sample_regime: 10 weeks of raging early-2021 bull market. Verdicts are bounded to this sample.
